sections.description: Generates a client-side JSON search index and powers fuzzy search with local Fuse.js for Simply Static exports.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/static-search-index directory, or install via GitHub releases.
  2. Activate the plugin through the 'Plugins' screen in WordPress.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Fixed issue where subdirectory paths from staging/origin URLs (e.g. /shajananddigital) leaked into search results on static root domains.
  • Added Simply Static destination URL detection and support for root-relative permalinks.
  • Added sahajanand_static_search_relative_path, sahajanand_static_search_destination_url, and sahajanand_static_search_entry filters.
  • Added client-side fallback in static-search.js to resolve clean permalinks across both dynamic and static environments.

1.0.2

  • Added unique static version query parameter (?version=X) to avoid browser and CDN caching on static site updates.
  • Added Simply Static export hooks to auto-bump version on export.

1.0.1

  • Added support for public custom post types in search index generation.
  • Renamed main plugin classes to Sahajanand_Static_Search.
  • Added self-hosted update checker support.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
